```{r}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)

```

# Functions to generate networks

#### Random network:

```{r}
randgraph <- function(nodes, kbar = NULL) {
  
  p <- kbar / (nodes - 1)
  g <- sample_gnp(nodes, p, directed = FALSE, loops = FALSE)
  return(g)
}
```

#### Small-world network:

```{r}
#nei=Integer constant, the neighborhood within which the vertices of the lattice will be connected.p=Real constant between zero and one, the rewiring probability(from help function)
smallworldgraph <- function(nodes, kbar = NULL, prob = 0.1) {
  neighbours <- floor(kbar/2)
  swg <- sample_smallworld(dim = 1, size = nodes, nei = neighbours, p = prob)
  return(swg)
}
```

#### Scale-free networks:

```{r}
#numeric constant = m (number of edges to add in each time step according to help function)
scalefreegraph <- function(nodes, kbar = NULL) {

  m <-floor(kbar/2)

  sfg <- sample_pa(nodes, m=m, directed = FALSE, zero.appeal = 1)
  
  return(sfg)
}
```

# Plotting networks:

```{r}
plotnet <- function(network_generated){
  net <- ggraph(network_generated,layout="fr")+geom_edge_link(alpha=0.5)+geom_node_point(size=1)+theme_void()
  return(net)
}
```

# Performing community detection:

```{r}
louvaincd <- function(network_gen){
  cdlo <- cluster_louvain(network_gen)
  return(cdlo)
}

```

```{r}
leidencd <- function(network_gen){
  cdlei <- cluster_leiden(network_gen,objective_function = "modularity")
  return(cdlei)
}
```

# Metrics:

## Modularity:

```{r}
modularityll <- function(network_gen, cl_louvain = NULL, cl_leiden = NULL) {
  
  # Compute modularity for Louvain 
  louvain_mod <- if (!is.null(cl_louvain)) modularity(network_gen, membership(cl_louvain)) else NA_real_
  
  # Compute modularity for Leiden 
  leiden_mod  <- if (!is.null(cl_leiden)) modularity(network_gen, membership(cl_leiden)) else NA_real_
  
  data.frame(
    modularity_louvain = louvain_mod,
    modularity_leiden  = leiden_mod,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

```

## Conductance:

```{r}

conductance_safe <- function(graph, group) {
  # Return NA if group is empty or the whole graph
  if (length(group) == 0 || length(group) == vcount(graph)) return(NA_real_)
  
  S <- V(graph)[group]
  S_bar <- V(graph)[!V(graph) %in% S]
  
  # Number of edges crossing between S and S_bar
  cut_edges <- ecount(graph) -
               ecount(induced_subgraph(graph, S)) -
               ecount(induced_subgraph(graph, S_bar))
  
  # Volumes (sum of degrees)
  vol_S <- sum(degree(graph, S))
  vol_Sbar <- sum(degree(graph, S_bar))
  
  cut_edges / min(vol_S, vol_Sbar)
}

conductancell <- function(network_gen, cl_louvain = NULL, cl_leiden = NULL) {
  
  safe_cond <- function(cl) {
    if (is.null(cl)) return(NA_real_)
    groups <- split(V(network_gen), membership(cl))
    if (length(groups) <= 1) return(NA_real_)  # skip if only 1 community
    vals <- vapply(groups, function(g) conductance_safe(network_gen, g), numeric(1))
    mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  data.frame(
    conductance_louvain = safe_cond(cl_louvain),
    conductance_leiden  = safe_cond(cl_leiden),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}


```

## Stability:

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("aricode", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("aricode")
}
library(aricode)

# Helper to normalize memberships
normalize_membership <- function(mem) {
  as.integer(factor(mem))
}


stability <- function(network_gen, n_runs, compare_method = "nmi") {
  
  results <- list()
  
  for (algo in c("louvain", "leiden")) {
    communities <- vector("list", n_runs)
    
    # Generate communities for each run
    for (i in 1:n_runs) {
      cl_obj <- if (algo == "louvain") {
        louvaincd(network_gen)
      } else {
        leidencd(network_gen)
      }
      communities[[i]] <- normalize_membership(membership(cl_obj))
    }
    
    # Compute pairwise similarity (NMI or ARI)
    similarities <- numeric(0)
    for (i in 1:(n_runs - 1)) {
      for (j in (i + 1):n_runs) {
        sim <- switch(compare_method,
                      nmi = aricode::NMI(communities[[i]], communities[[j]]),
                      ari = aricode::ARI(communities[[i]], communities[[j]]),
                      stop("Unsupported compare_method. Use 'nmi' or 'ari'."))
        similarities <- c(similarities, sim)
      }
    }
    
    results[[algo]] <- mean(similarities)
  }
  
  return(c(stability_louvain = results$louvain,
           stability_leiden  = results$leiden))
}


```

##Plotting networks before and after community detection

###Random network

```{r}
set.seed(123)
#just a test case
nodes <- 10
edges <- 20
net <- randgraph(nodes,edges)
plotnet(net)
# Louvain membership
lou_1 <- louvaincd(net)
memb_lou <- membership(cluster_louvain(net))

#Leiden membership
lei_1 <- leidencd(net)
memb_lei <- membership(lei_1)

# Side-by-side plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))  # 1 row, 2 columns

# Louvain plot
plot(net,
     vertex.color = memb_lou,
     vertex.label = NA,
     vertex.size = 6,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.5,
     main = paste("Louvain (", length(unique(memb_lou)), " communities)", sep = "")
)

# Leiden plot
plot(net,
     vertex.color = memb_lei,
     vertex.label = NA,
     vertex.size = 6,
     edge.arrow.size = 0.5,
     main = paste("Leiden (", length(unique(memb_lei)), " communities)", sep = "")
)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
modularityll(net)
conductancell(net)
stability_results <- stability(net, n_runs = 5)
stability_results
```

```{r}
twosizes_random <- function(sizes = c(10, 15), n_runs = 100, stability_repeats = 100, kbar=NULL) {
  df <- data.frame()
  for (size in sizes) {
    for (i in 1:n_runs) {
      set.seed(i) 
      g <- randgraph(nodes=size, kbar=kbar)

      louvain <- louvaincd(g)
      leiden  <- leidencd(g)
      
      mods <- modularityll(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      cons <- conductancell(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      stability_vals <- stability(g, n_runs = stability_repeats)
      
      df <- rbind(df, data.frame(
        graph_size = size,
        run = i,
        network = "Random",
        kbar = kbar,
        number_of_communities_louvain = length(unique(membership(louvain))),
        number_of_communities_leiden  = length(unique(membership(leiden))),
        modularity_louvain  = mods$modularity_louvain[1],
        modularity_leiden   = mods$modularity_leiden[1],
        conductance_louvain = cons$conductance_louvain,
        conductance_leiden  = cons$conductance_leiden,
        stability_louvain = stability_vals["stability_louvain"],
        stability_leiden  = stability_vals["stability_leiden"]
      ))
    }
  }
  return(df)
}

size_pairs <- list(
  c(16, 32),
  c(64, 128),
  c(256, 512)
)
kbars <- c(4, 6, 8, 10)
n_runs <- 100
stability_repeats <- 50

rds_file <- "dens_size_random.rds"
if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
  df_all <- readRDS(rds_file)
} else {
  df_all <- data.frame()
}


for (k in kbars) {

  for (pair in size_pairs) {
    
    df_new <- twosizes_random(
      sizes = pair,
      n_runs = n_runs,
      stability_repeats = stability_repeats,
      kbar = k
    )

    df_all <- rbind(df_all, df_new)
    saveRDS(df_all, rds_file)
  }
}

```

```{r}
twosizes_smallworld <- function(sizes = c(10, 15), p = 0.1, n_runs = 100, stability_repeats = 100, kbar = 1) {
  dfsw <- data.frame()
  for (size in sizes) {
    for (i in 1:n_runs) {
      set.seed(i) 
      g <- smallworldgraph(size, kbar=kbar,prob=p)

      louvain <- louvaincd(g)
      leiden  <- leidencd(g)
      
      mods <- modularityll(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      cons <- conductancell(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      stability_vals <- stability(g, n_runs = stability_repeats)
      
      dfsw <- rbind(dfsw, data.frame(
        graph_size = size,
        run = i,
        network = "Small-world",
        kbar = kbar,
        number_of_communities_louvain = length(unique(membership(louvain))),
        number_of_communities_leiden  = length(unique(membership(leiden))),
        modularity_louvain  = mods$modularity_louvain[1],
        modularity_leiden   = mods$modularity_leiden[1],
        conductance_louvain = cons$conductance_louvain,
        conductance_leiden  = cons$conductance_leiden,
        stability_louvain = stability_vals["stability_louvain"],
        stability_leiden  = stability_vals["stability_leiden"]
      ))
    }
  }
  return(dfsw)
}

size_pairs <- list(
  c(16, 32),
  c(64, 128),
  c(256, 512)
)
kbars <- c(4, 6, 8, 10)
n_runs <- 100
stability_repeats <- 50

rds_file <- "dens_size_sw.rds"
if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
  df_all <- readRDS(rds_file)
} else {
  df_all <- data.frame()
}

for (k in kbars) {
  
  for (pair in size_pairs) {
    
    df_new <- twosizes_smallworld(
      sizes = pair,
      n_runs = n_runs,
      stability_repeats = stability_repeats,
      kbar = k
    )
    

    df_all <- rbind(df_all, df_new)
    

    saveRDS(df_all, rds_file)
  }
}
```

```{r}
twosizes_scalefree <- function(sizes = c(10, 15), n_runs = 100, stability_repeats = 50, kbar = 1) {
  dfsf <- data.frame()
  for (size in sizes) {
    for (i in 1:n_runs) {
      set.seed(i)
      g <- scalefreegraph(size,kbar)

      louvain <- louvaincd(g)
      leiden  <- leidencd(g)
      
      mods <- modularityll(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      cons <- conductancell(g,cl_louvain = louvain,cl_leiden = leiden)
      stability_vals <- stability(g, n_runs = stability_repeats)
      
      dfsf <- rbind(dfsf, data.frame(
        graph_size = size,
        run = i,
        network = "Scale-free",
        kbar = kbar,
        number_of_communities_louvain = length(unique(membership(louvain))),
        number_of_communities_leiden  = length(unique(membership(leiden))),
        modularity_louvain  = mods$modularity_louvain[1],
        modularity_leiden   = mods$modularity_leiden[1],
        conductance_louvain = cons$conductance_louvain,
        conductance_leiden  = cons$conductance_leiden,
        stability_louvain = stability_vals["stability_louvain"],
        stability_leiden  = stability_vals["stability_leiden"]
      ))
    }
  }
  return(dfsf)
}

size_pairs <- list(
  c(16, 32),
  c(64, 128),
  c(256, 512)
)
kbars <- c(4, 6, 8, 10)
resolutions <- seq(0.5, 5, by = 0.5)
n_runs <- 100
stability_repeats <- 50

rds_file <- "res_results_sf.rds"
if (file.exists(rds_file)) {
  df_all <- readRDS(rds_file)
} else {
  df_all <- data.frame()
}


for (k in kbars) {
  
  for (pair in size_pairs) {
    
    df_new <- twosizes_scalefree(
      sizes = pair,
      n_runs = n_runs,
      stability_repeats = stability_repeats,
      kbar = k
    )
    
    df_all <- rbind(df_all, df_new)
    saveRDS(df_all, rds_file)
  }
}
```
